Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.versions

Interface PlatformVersionsService.Status

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    PlatformVersionsServiceImpl.StatusImpl
    Enclosing interface:
    PlatformVersionsService
    public static interface PlatformVersionsService.Status
    Information about the status of a versionable in the workspace wrt. a release, or of a versionable within a release wrt. a previous release.

      • getVersionReference

        @Nullable
@Nullable VersionReference getVersionReference()
        The latest version reference - when comparing workspace to release, this is in the release; when comparing release to release, this is in getNextRelease(). Might be null in case of PlatformVersionsService.ActivationState.initial.

      • getNextRelease

        @Nullable
@Nullable Release getNextRelease()
        The release we compare from. If we compare the workspace, this is null.

      • getNextVersionable

        @Nullable
@Nullable ReleasedVersionable getNextVersionable()
        The detail information about the versionable as it is in the workspace / the release if we're comparing a release with a previous release. This is null if the status refers to a deleted versionable.

      • getPreviousRelease

        @Nullable
@Nullable Release getPreviousRelease()
        The release getPreviousVersionable() is about (see there). When comparing workspace to release this is not null, when comparing release to release this might be null (if there was no previous release).

      • getPreviousVersionable

        @Nullable
@Nullable ReleasedVersionable getPreviousVersionable()
        The detail information about the versionable within the release if the status is about the workspace / within the previous release if it's comparing two releases. This is null if the versionable is PlatformVersionsService.ActivationState.initial / if the previous release did not contain the versionable at all.

      • getWorkspaceResource

        @Nullable
@Nullable org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource getWorkspaceResource()
        The workspace resource (versionable) that corresponds to the released stuff.
